localBiteReport: Reports from the final week of October through the first week of November 2026 show Choctawhatchee Bay in solid fall form. Capt. Adam Schroeder of Ignite The Bite Charters (Destin) calls the redfish bite around the Destin bridges and passes one of the most reliable opportunities heading into November, with fish largely in the 25–26" class and an occasional larger bull mixed in, responding well to a variety of live baits including pinfish, croakers, and cigar minnows. Capt. Blake Nelson of Last Cast Charters reported the previous week that sight-fishing for slot reds on the bay flats remained productive despite a recent hurricane, with fish in the sub-23" range still holding in familiar guts and potholes; a post-cold-front shift moved the best bite toward larger natural bait chunks rather than artificials. Speckled trout in the 22–27" range are showing up wherever anglers can locate bait concentrations, and the sheepshead bite is expected to pick up further as temperatures continue to drop. Note: Florida FWC's statewide flounder closure runs October 15 through November 30, so flounder are not currently a legal target in the bay. Water temperature at this location is 75°F.
